title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ("Cross-site Scripting") vulnerability in Drupal USWDS…
description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ("Cross-site Scripting") vulnerability in Drupal USWDS Paragraph Components allows Stored XSS. This issue affects USWDS Paragraph Components versions: from 0.0.0 to 3.1.3.
